## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No private keys, seed phrases, API keys, or `.env.local` values are included.
- [ ] The change does not add wallet signing, custody, or automated trading execution.
- [ ] Data source and fallback behavior remain clear to users.
